Name: Dead-Air Sphere
Description: You summon a monochromatic sphere that falls down around a point of your choice that you can see, encompassing a 30-ft radius. All creatures within the area must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or have their perception of time cut out for a brief second, causing them to suffer 6 Tremor and then trigger Tremor Burst, or only suffer half that count on a success.
At Higher Levels: For each Spell Slot Level spent above 3rd you deal an additional 2 Tremor.
